name: contracts
description: This project demonstrates a basic Hardhat use case. It comes with a sample contract, a test for that contract, and a Hardhat Ignition module that deploys that contract.

scripts.deploy:ignition: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Web3dbModule.js --network hardhat
scripts.deploy:localhost: npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Web3dbModule.js --network localhost
